# Gantt

Show the tasks of a project on a timeline.

## Example 1

=== "Diagram"

    ```mermaid
    gantt
        title Git Issues - days since last update
        dateFormat X
        axisFormat %s
        section Issue19062
        71   : 0, 71
        section Issue19401
        36   : 0, 36
        section Issue193
        34   : 0, 34
        section Issue7441
        9    : 0, 9
        section Issue1300
        5    : 0, 5
    ```

=== "Markdown"

    ````markdown
    ```mermaid
    gantt
        title Git Issues - days since last update
        dateFormat X
        axisFormat %s
        section Issue19062
        71   : 0, 71
        section Issue19401
        36   : 0, 36
        section Issue193
        34   : 0, 34
        section Issue7441
        9    : 0, 9
        section Issue1300
        5    : 0, 5
    ```
    ````

## Example 2

=== "Diagram"

    ```mermaid
    gantt
        title A Gantt Diagram
        %% This is a comment
        dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
        section Section
            A task          :a1, 2014-01-01, 30d
            Another task    :after a1, 20d
        section Another
            Task in Another :2014-01-12, 12d
            another task    :24d
    ```

=== "Markdown"

    ````markdown
    ```mermaid
    gantt
        title A Gantt Diagram
        %% This is a comment
        dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
        section Section
            A task          :a1, 2014-01-01, 30d
            Another task    :after a1, 20d
        section Another
            Task in Another :2014-01-12, 12d
            another task    :24d
    ```
    ````
